user.title: Finance Insights
user.description: Choose what to add. Add one entry per account, then optionally the overview.

menu_options.bank: Bank account (Sparkasse and other FinTS banks)

import_legacy.title: Import from Trade Republic Insights
import_legacy.description: Moves your existing Trade Republic setup (folder: {folder}) into Finance Insights. The old entry is removed, and the entity IDs sensor.trade_republic_* and their history stay the same.

trade_republic.title: Trade Republic
trade_republic.description: Put the Trade Republic CSV exports of this account into the folder (relative to {config_dir}). Use a separate folder for every account. The newest CSV is used. Optional files: prices.csv (symbol,price) and bonds.csv.

data.name: Name, for example Trade Republic Anna
data.use_pytr: Also sync automatically via pytr (unofficial API)

pytr.title: Trade Republic login
pytr.description: pytr uses the unofficial Trade Republic web API. After you submit, Trade Republic sends a login confirmation to your phone. The PIN is stored in the config entry so the session can be renewed.

pytr_confirm.title: Confirm in the app
pytr_confirm.description: Confirm the login in the Trade Republic app, then select Submit.

pytr_confirm_code.title: Authenticator code
pytr_confirm_code.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

bank.title: Bank account
bank.description: Export your transactions in online banking as CSV-CAMT V2 and put the files into this folder (relative to {config_dir}). Overlapping exports are merged. Optional files: balance.csv (iban,date,balance) and categories.csv (pattern,category).

data.name: Name
data.use_fints: Also sync automatically via FinTS (needs a FinTS product ID)

fints.title: FinTS access
fints.description: Look up the bank code and FinTS server of your bank, for example on the bank website. The login name is the one from online banking. The product ID comes from your free registration at the Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft. The PIN and product ID are stored in the config entry.

fints_tan.title: Confirm in the banking app
fints_tan.description:
Your bank asks for a confirmation: {challenge}

Confirm it in your TAN app, then select Submit.

fints_tan_code.title: Enter TAN
fints_tan_code.description: Your bank asks for a TAN: {challenge}

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Adds net worth, income, spending, and savings rate. Without members, all accounts are included. With members, only the accounts owned by these people, for example one overview per person and one for a couple. Transfers between accounts of the same person are not counted as income or spending.

reauth_confirm.title: Login expired
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your PIN to start a new login.

error.phone_format: Use the international format, for example +4915112345678.
error.server_format: The server URL starts with https://.
error.install_failed: The required package could not be installed. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.login_failed: Login failed. Check the details, then try again. The Home Assistant log contains the reason.
error.not_confirmed: The login is not confirmed yet. Confirm it in the app, then select Submit again.

abort.no_legacy: No Trade Republic Insights entry found.

data.transfer_keywords: Keywords for transfers to your depot (comma separated)

data_description.owner: The Home Assistant user this account belongs to. It counts in their overviews, and its dashboard views are shown to them.
data_description.shared_with: These users also see the dashboard views of this account. This only hides views in the dashboard: every Home Assistant user can still read all sensors.
data_description.members: Accounts owned by these people are included. Leave empty for all accounts.
data_description.fints_hours: Every FinTS sync is a bank login. Some banks ask for a new confirmation after 90 days.
data_description.transfer_keywords: Bookings whose name or purpose contains one of these words count as investments, not as spending.
data_description.offset_rules: One rule per line: text => category. A credit whose payee or purpose contains the text counts as a refund in that category, for example Semester => Education. Categories: Rent and housing, Utilities, Phone and internet, Insurance, Health, Groceries, Drugstore, Restaurants and delivery, Transport, Fuel and car, Travel, Subscriptions, Online shopping, Shopping, Sports and leisure, Education, Taxes and fees, Donations, Cash.

build_dashboard.name: Build dashboard
build_dashboard.description: Overwrites a dashboard with one view per account and overview. Each view is visible only to its owner, shared users, or overview members. The dashboard is rebuilt automatically when accounts change.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.description: URL path of an existing dashboard created in the UI, for example dashboard-finances. Its content is replaced.

dashboard_not_found.message: Dashboard {dashboard} not found. Create it under Settings > Dashboards first and use the part of its URL after the slash.
